instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Give people paid access by hand, all at once or one by one (members who moved over from another place, a gift, a pass with an end date), and end a grant I gave", and give it grants (The access to give, one item per person and access ref; leave empty when only revoking).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:grant-paid-access-to-people and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Writes one access-grant record for each grant: the person (subject, named the way your access rules name a buyer), the access ref they now hold, an optional grant_ref that names the grant (left out, it is "grant:" and the access ref), an optional window (valid_from_ms and expires_at_ms together, whole milliseconds since 1970, the end after the start) and an optional note.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: access-grant (records:read, records:write).
